taglines: Thursday. The day where Friday is visible on the horizon but still absolutely will not come any faster. You can see the finish line. It sees you. It is unmoved.
Your retro action items are due today. The action items from last retro are still open. The action items from the retro before that are what we now call 'the culture.'
Someone is writing documentation. Right now. Somewhere. They will finish it next Tuesday. It will be immediately out of date by Tuesday afternoon. We salute them.
You opened a tab two weeks ago you fully intended to read. It is still open. Your laptop fan hates it. You know what it is. You won't close it. Neither would I.
The PR has been 'almost ready' for four days. It was ready on day one. The author keeps thinking of one more thing. There is always one more thing. There is no end to the thing.
Nine AM on a Thursday and someone in the meeting said 'let's take this offline.' They will never take it offline. It is online forever now, unresolved, in the chat.
You have survived 100% of your Thursdays so far. Statistically insignificant. Emotionally vital. This one is yours too. Drink water. Close a ticket. Feel nothing.
Friday is tomorrow but Thursday has a full calendar. Three syncs, one demo, one review, and a 'quick call' that is never quick. Thursday is Friday's disappointed parent.
